items.title: Amos White Interview, 1958-08-23
items.q: the manager of the of the Minstrel show asked me would I take the band over. I said, Charles E. Boeing. And I did.

ctx.x: Was it like an orchestra or brass band? Out of that we had always a ten piece orchestra

to play the show in the pit. We had violinists, piccolo players, bass viol players, all of the instruments that go along. We had five clarinets in this band, and a fine piccolo player, Jared. And later on we got Clarence Owens, who now directs the 8th Regiment Band in Chicago. 8th Illinois Regiment. Ward officer Clarence Owens. The next season Jeff quit, and the manager of the of the Minstrel show asked me would I take the band over. I said, Charles E. Boeing. And I did. But I didn't complete the season, because…
